answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require stake-backed work bonds: every agent locks a refundable deposit before offering services, and peers attest completed work on-ledger. Forging identities then costs real capital per copy, while honest agents recover their bond plus fees. The old fable of free, unlimited identities dies once each haven of trust demands collateral; a lone canyon of unverified agents cannot flood the market, because bonds make mass forgery unprofitable and slashing strips cheaters of their deposits.
